title: oldenlandia arnottiana
intro: Oldenlandia arnottiana, commonly known as "Hong Quai" in traditional Chinese medicine, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, as well as lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Oldenlandia arnottiana are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which help to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
